note: Polk County AR has a county zoning ordinance (2014/2021), but its county GIS server (gis.polk-county.net) publishes only aerials, drone imagery, LiDAR, utilities and historic zoning map images (ImageServers, token-protected folder), and the county open data hub lists no zoning district polygon layer (only a Future Land Use 2030 item). No zoning district service found for Mena, Cove, Grannis, Hatfield or Wickes either; their websites link no zoning GIS.
